t: You are looking at number 1 Chelsea Embankment, known as Shelley House, along with its railings. It is a house in Chelsea with two notable connections. St John Hornby lived here. He was a founding partner of W. H. Smith, and he founded and owned the Ashendene Press. Rosamund Holland-Martin was born here. She became Dame Rosamund, and spent many years as a leader and fund-raiser for the National Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Children, the NSPCC.
